scenarios.title: Small bug remains planning-first
scenarios.boundary: Host wording may differ; persisted Planning Lock and Start Report are required.

scenarios.title: Hands-free work preserves programme planning
scenarios.boundary: No implementation result is inferred from the planning bundle.

scenarios.title: Rejected requirement stays in the same run
scenarios.boundary: A rejection cannot silently create a replacement run or authorize source writes.

scenarios.title: Evidence failure blocks completion
scenarios.boundary: A passing local check cannot override an unresolved requirement evidence gap.

scenarios.title: Recovery preserves approved and unrelated work
scenarios.boundary: The receipt proves the selected task boundary only; it does not claim Git rollback occurred unless linked evidence says so.

scenarios.title: CI wait does not create acceptance learning
scenarios.boundary: CI acceptance requires a linked trusted-CI receipt; waiting is not acceptance.

boundary: Host-independent observable contracts. Exact assistant wording is never a conformance requirement.
